patthana16.92:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ niyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na niyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.92:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ aniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho na aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika niyataduke na sanidassanattika naniyatadukaṃ
